notes: episode_number is 1-indexed and monotonically increasing. principle_index = (episode_number - 1) % 12. pass_number = (episode_number - 1) // 12 (0-indexed pass through the 12 principles). lens_index = pass_number % 4. This gives: pass 0 = all 12 principles through the Disciple lens, pass 1 = all 12 through Warrant Officer, pass 2 = all 12 through Business Owner, pass 3 = all 12 through Father/Husband, pass 4 = back to Disciple (2nd time through), etc.
